C-SITE-COUNTERS.Name: First-party counters — implementation plan
C-SITE-COUNTERS.IntentSummary: Move the collector from ad-hoc env reads into resolveSiteSettings (collect: { key, endpoint } | null, validated), describe its script tag once (collectTags/collectScript, base-aware) for both the docs head and the landing template, admit its origin in the meta CSP connect-src only when configured, pin resolution, tag emission, the CSP allowance and the analytics.js beacon contract in tests/site/analytics.test.mjs, and record the behaviour in M-053/V-M-053.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: landing.mjs exports DEFAULT_COLLECT_ENDPOINT, COLLECT_KEY_RE, collectTags(collect, base) and collectScript(collect, base), and resolveSiteSettings returns collect ({ key, endpoint }) validated by checked('PUBLIC_COLLECT_KEY', …) or null; collectScript renders the same attributes through escapeAttr and stays '' for null; the module map and change summary are updated.

Verification.Command: node -e "import('./site/.vitepress/landing.mjs').then(m => { const s = m.resolveSiteSettings({ PUBLIC_COLLECT_KEY: 'demo-key' }); if (s.collect.key !== 'demo-key') process.exit(1); if (m.collectScript(null) !== '') process.exit(1); })"

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: cspFor(html, { analytics, collect }) appends new URL(collect.endpoint).origin to connect-src when collect is set and appends nothing when it is null; the unconfigured policy is byte-identical to today's; csp.mjs PURPOSE/SCOPE/MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY name the collector; config.mts passes collect to applyCsp.

Verification.Command: node -e "import('./site/scripts/csp.mjs').then(m => { const a = m.cspFor('', { collect: { endpoint: 'https://dash.example.test/api/v1/collect' } }); if (!a.includes('https://dash.example.test')) process.exit(1); const b = m.cspFor('', {}); if (b.includes('dash.example.test')) process.exit(1); })"

T-003.Title: Tag emission on both surfaces (spec R-2)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: config.mts emits the collector tag in the docs head only when settings.collect is set (no keyless data-key="" tag), replaces %ANALYTICS% in the landing template with collectScript(settings.collect, base), and passes the same collect into applyCsp; the CHANGE_SUMMARY records it.

Verification.Command: cd site && PUBLIC_COLLECT_KEY=demo-key npm run build

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: tests/site/analytics.test.mjs covers resolution (default, explicit endpoint, malformed key), collectScript/collectTags on both base values, the connect-src allowance and its absence, and the analytics.js runtime (no beacon without a key; one beacon to the configured endpoint carrying the key and a pageview event when a batch flushes); M-053 gains the collector sources/tests, V-M-053 the command and scenario-15; lint current reports its baseline.

Gates.Gate: npx vitest run tests/site — green, including the new suite.
cd site && PUBLIC_COLLECT_KEY=demo-key npm run build — built pages carry both the tag and the collector origin in connect-src.
grace lint --path . --change C-SITE-COUNTERS --assertions final --run-commands — zero findings outside the recorded baseline.

CornerMatrix.Corner: The origin in connect-src is derived from the same endpoint string the tag carries, so a custom PUBLIC_COLLECT_ENDPOINT moves both together and cannot drift; an unconfigured build produces the same policy and the same HTML as before this change, which keeps C-64 scenario-10's provider toggles untouched.

The allowance is one origin, added only when the owner configured a collector; no 'unsafe-inline', no wildcard, script-src still admits only 'self' plus hashes plus configured provider hosts. The key stays public by design and is validated before inlining, so a malformed value cannot break out of the attribute (escapeAttr still runs) and fails the build instead.

Landing and docs now behave identically: counters on when configured, completely absent otherwise (no keyless request to /analytics.js). Visitors see no difference; a cookieless counter sends one beacon per batch and nothing else.
One defer script adds a request only when configured; the policy gains a single connect-src token; the build gains no step.
M-053/V-M-053 now name the source set and the scenario the branch actually ships, so the next refresh sees the collector as governed rather than unexplained drift.
Reverting the three site files plus the test restores the previous (inert) wiring in one commit; the governance entries are additive and independently revertible.
